statements.subject: client
statements.description: A2A Client: An application or agent that initiates requests to an A2A Server on behalf of a user or another system.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A2A Server (Remote Agent): An agent or agentic system that exposes an A2A-compliant endpoint, processing tasks and providing responses.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Message role 'user': a communication turn having role 'user', originating from a user or client.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Message role 'agent': a communication turn having role 'agent', originating from the remote agent.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Message: A communication turn between a client and a remote agent, having a role ("user" or "agent") and containing one or more Parts.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Message: A communication turn between a client and a remote agent, having a role ("user" or "agent") and containing one or more Parts.

statements.subject: message
statements.guard_semantics: exactly one of allowed_values must be present in message.role; becomes NuXMV INVAR not a per-transition guard

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Task: The fundamental unit of work managed by A2A, identified by a unique ID. Tasks are stateful and progress through a defined lifecycle.

statements.subject: part
statements.description: Part: The smallest unit of content within a Message or Artifact. Parts can contain text, file references, or structured data.
statements.guard_semantics: exactly one of allowed_values must be present as the content type of a Part; becomes NuXMV INVAR not a per-transition guard

statements.subject: artifact
statements.description: Artifact: An output (e.g., a document, image, structured data) generated by the agent as a result of a task, composed of Parts.

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Agent Card: A JSON metadata document published by an A2A Server, describing its identity, capabilities, skills, service endpoint, and authentication requirements.
